label: Label
side1_option: Side 1: reference, azimuth, frequency response, VTA, wow & flutter
procedure: Procedure: start the live measurement and play the loudest band (side 2, band 1): nothing may turn red → stop → “Record side” → stylus to the start of the side → let the whole side play → lift the stylus → stop. The analysis finds the bands by itself. To fine-tune the bias: live measurement, play the anti-skating band and watch THD+N left/right.

audio_retention_deleted: Original audio deleted after the retention period; the measurements are kept.
as_title: Anti-skating ramp: distortion per channel over level
as_hint: If one channel distorts clearly earlier than the other, the bias is off: left first = anti-skating too strong, right first = too weak. Both clean to the end = good.
res_hint: Green background: target band {lo}–{hi} Hz. Dashed: model (2nd-order high-pass), giving the resonance frequency and peak.
wf_title: Wow & flutter: deviation of the 3150 Hz tone
compare_hint: Same logic as before/after for cleaning: what did the change achieve? ▲ = better. Two runs without a change show how much the measurement scatters by itself.
